title: RAG-based Automated Support System
description: An automated customer support system built with n8n for workflow orchestration and OpenAI-powered AI agents for diagnosing and resolving user queries. Agents analyze incoming issues, retrieve past solutions, and automate resolution end-to-end, cutting human intervention by 40%. A self-learning knowledge base backed by Pinecone improves response accuracy over time.

title: Telecom Customer Churn Prediction
description: End-to-end churn analysis on a telecom dataset, using feature engineering and exploratory data analysis to uncover churn patterns. Built and evaluated multiple machine learning models — Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost — achieving 81.2% accuracy in identifying at-risk customers.

title: Predictive Maintenance Application
description: A Flask-based predictive maintenance app using deep learning models on industrial time-series data, achieving 86.24% accuracy in Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction. Combines RUL prediction, clustering, speech recognition (OpenAI Whisper API), and anomaly detection (Granger Causality) in one pipeline, with an RMSE of 44.08 and a Silhouette Score of 0.563.
